description: Paid ($0.01): Parses a statement and adds analysis: monthly totals, top counterparties, recurring payments, suspected duplicates, largest transactions and balance reconciliation. Set include_transactions=false to receive only the analysis. JSON body up to 1000 KB. Failed calls (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Without a payment header the result is the x402 payment requirements.

columns.description: CSV: map field names (date, amount, description, ...) to exact header names.

content.description: The statement file as text (UTF-8). PDF and scanned images are not supported.

currency.description: Fallback ISO 4217 currency when the file has none, e.g. SEK.

dateFormat.description: CSV date order override for ambiguous dates.

delimiter.description: CSV delimiter override: comma, semicolon, tab or pipe.

includeRaw.description: Add the raw source fields to every transaction.

include_transactions.description: Default true. false returns only the analysis.

today.description: YYYY-MM-DD; flags recurring payments that stopped before this date.

name: analyze_statement
